attempts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Edit image 1 into ONE matching rehabilitation demonstration photograph for action 041 E-AXU-008 step s02. Images 2–4 are identity/style references only. Preserve image 1's exact adult East Asian woman, face, age, black ponytail, white short-sleeve T-shirt, dark charcoal long pants, white sneakers, grey stationary armless chair, grey-blue seamless studio floor and background, soft diffuse lighting, camera position, portrait framing, subject size and entire head-to-shoes composition. Change ONLY the seated upper torso posture: with both arms still crossed naturally across the chest, hands visible on opposite upper arms, turn the CHEST and shoulders comfortably about 35 degrees toward HER OWN ANATOMICAL LEFT; the head follows the chest naturally with a relaxed neutral neck. Her anatomical left is toward the image RIGHT because she is viewed from the front, slightly oblique. This should turn her upper chest further toward image RIGHT, away from the fixed forward direction of her knees. Pelvis stays seated level and facing forward; BOTH thighs, knees and feet stay at their original locations pointing forward and both complete soles remain flat on floor. Chair remains EXACTLY stationary, not rotated. Keep upright spine, no backward arch, no side leaning. Make thoracic rotation obvious by the shoulder line and sternum orientation relative to unchanged knees. Crossed arms move WITH chest, do not pull chair or uncross. Natural anatomy, continuous joints, exactly two arms and two legs, proper visible fingers. ONE static pose, not a collage. No text, number, label, arrows, watermark or extra people.
attempts.qa: 胸口旋转不足，主要是转头；返修。

attempts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Edit image 1 into the matching END pose of action 078 T-LOW-011 step s02, bilateral glute bridge. Images 2–4 are woman identity/style references only. Keep image 1's EXACT woman, face, black ponytail, white short-sleeve T-shirt, dark charcoal full-length trousers, BOTH white sneakers, grey nonslip mat, grey-blue seamless studio floor/background, soft lighting, high oblique lateral camera, landscape framing, head on image LEFT and feet on image RIGHT. Keep the same head, shoulder, hand and shoe positions, whole person in frame with full hands and shoes. Change ONLY by raising pelvis and buttocks into a moderate controlled two-foot bridge, so shoulder–hip–knee form an approximately straight diagonal line. Head and neck relaxed on mat, upper shoulder blades remain supported on mat. BOTH arms remain relaxed beside torso, BOTH full hands palm-down on mat. BOTH shoe soles fully flat and stable at their original locations and comfortable spacing, no foot sliding, heel rising or floating shoe; both knees remain bent and aligned over their feet. Lift through hip extension, level pelvis; maintain neutral lumbar spine, gently engaged abdomen and no dramatic lower-back arch or rib flare. Show clear visible air gap between buttocks/pelvis and mat, realistic torso-thigh proportions and continuous hip/knee joints. All of head, complete arms/hands, BOTH bent knees, BOTH ankles and BOTH shoes must be visible, mat contact points clear. ONE static photograph only, no text, arrows, labels, numbers, collage, watermark or extra limbs.

attempts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Precise pose correction to image 1, which currently mainly turns the head. KEEP everything below waist pixel-equivalent in placement: the identical stationary chair, pelvis, thighs, knees, flat white shoes, grey-blue background, camera and portrait framing. Keep exact same adult woman, face, ponytail, white T-shirt, charcoal pants, arms crossed and hands on opposite upper arms. REQUIRED CHANGE: rotate the ENTIRE ribcage, sternum, shoulders AND crossed arms together markedly toward the woman's ANATOMICAL LEFT (image RIGHT). Her seated hips and knees still point forward, but her chest now points diagonally toward image RIGHT at about 45 degrees relative to her pelvis. Make this a clearly visible SEATED THORACIC TWIST, not just neck rotation. The upper body should show a three-quarter side view toward image RIGHT, with visibly narrower projected chest and both crossed forearms rotated rigidly WITH the chest; the right shoulder comes forward, the left shoulder travels backward. White shirt torso folds must show axial rotation above a fixed forward-facing waistband. Head naturally follows the turned sternum, neck unstrained. Upright balanced trunk, no bending, no lateral tilt, no lumbar arch, no pulling chair, buttocks stay seated. Complete head, both hands, both knees and both shoes. Both soles stay flat. One pose only, no text/arrows/labels/collage/watermark. The chest rotation should be unmistakable when compared with unchanged forward-facing knees.
